lake.name: Still lake
lake.line: Cold and very clear. From the shore you can see stones on the bottom.

cairn.name: Stone cairn
cairn.line: A pile of stones someone stacked on purpose. It marks something. The path, maybe.

signpost.name: Wooden signpost
signpost.line: Letters you cannot read yet. An arrow points toward the water.

boat.name: Fishing boat
boat.line: A small boat with a blue hull. It smells strongly of fish and diesel.

fish-racks.name: Drying racks
fish-racks.line: Wooden frames with fish hanging in rows. The wind does the work.

harbour-wall.name: Harbour wall
harbour-wall.line: A long wall of huge dark stones. The waves hit the outside, the boats sit calm inside.

hot-pipe.name: Hot-water pipe
hot-pipe.line: A fat pipe running along the ground. It is warm to touch. Snow has melted on top of it.

sheep-pen.name: Sheep pen
sheep-pen.line: A ring of stone walls split into small pens, like slices of a pie. Mostly empty.

church.name: Little church
church.line: A small white church with a red roof. The door is not locked.
